title: Create a Custom Conversion
content_data:
Use this endpoint to create a Custom Conversion for a Pixel or an App. > **Note**
> - You can create a maximum of 1,000 Custom Conversions within an ad account. > - For a Pixel or an App, you can create a maximum of 100 Custom Conversions. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/custom_conversion/create/ **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1738373164380162).| |Content-Type {Required}|string|Request message type.
Allowed format: `application/json`. | ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | |advertiser_id {Required}|string|Advertiser ID.| |name {Required}|string|The name of the Custom Conversion.
The name must start with a letter and can include letters, numbers, spaces, underscores, or hyphens.

Length limit: 50 characters and cannot contain emoji.

Note:

  • Do not specify the name of a standard event.
  • Duplicate names for Custom Conversion within an ad account are not allowed.
| |description|string|The description of the Custom Conversion.

Length limit: 500 characters and cannot contain emoji.| |event_source_type {Required}|string|Event source type.

Enum values:
  • `PIXEL`: Pixel.
  • `APP`: App.
| |event_source_id {Required}|string|Event source ID.

  • When `event_source_type` is `PIXEL`, specify a Pixel ID.
    • To obtain IDs of Pixels within your ad account, use [/pixel/list/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1740858697598978) and check the returned `pixel_id`.
  • When `event_source_type` is `APP`, specify the app platform ID of a Self Attribution Network (SAN) App.
    • This app can only be used with the TikTok App Events SDK. The SDK creates a direct first-party connection from your app to TikTok, reducing signal loss and providing more accurate measurement. Learn [how to install the SDK](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1739584951798785).
    • To obtain app platform IDs of SAN Apps within your ad account, use [/app/list/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1740859313270786). Confirm that the returned `self_attribution_enabled` for the App is `true` and check the returned `app_platform_id`.
| |optimization_event{+Conditional}|string|
  • Required in any of the following scenarios:
    • When `event_source_type` is `PIXEL`.
    • When `event_source_type` is `APP` and you are creating a custom conversion using a standard event.
    • When `event_source_type` is `APP` and you are creating a custom conversion using a Custom Event, and the app is allowlisted for mapping Custom Events to Standard Events.
  • Not supported when the following conditions are all met:
    • `event_source_type` is `APP`.
    • You are creating a custom conversion using a Custom Event.
    • The app is not allowlisted for mapping Custom Events to Standard Events.

The Standard Event to associate with the Custom Conversion.

For enum values, see List of values for `optimization_event`.

Note: Mapping Custom Events to Standard Events while creating custom conversions using an app event source and a custom event is currently an allowlist-only feature. If you would like to access it, please contact your TikTok representative.

| |custom_event_type|string|Valid only when the Custom Event has been configured for the App or Pixel (`event_source_id`).

The Custom Event to associate with the Custom Conversion.
When you specify a Custom Event for the Custom Conversion, you need to specify the Standard Event to map the event to through `optimization_event` simultaneously.
Custom Events are actions that TikTok partners can define themselves beyond the predefined Standard Events list. To learn more about Custom Events, see [About Custom Events in TikTok Ads Manager](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article/custom-events).

To obtain the Custom Events that are configured for a Pixel, use [/pixel/list/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1740858697598978) and check the returned `custom_event_type`.

Note: When creating custom conversions using an app event source and a custom event, ensure that postbacks of the specified App Custom Event (`custom_event_type`) have been received before this custom conversion can be created. Otherwise, an error will occur.

| |rules {Required}|object[]|Details of the conversion rules for the Custom Conversion.

Only actions that meet these conditions will count as Custom Conversions.

Size range: 1-10.| #|parameter {Required}|string|Parameter.

Enum values:
  • `BRAND`: `brand`.
  • `CONTENT_CATEGORY`: `content_category`.
  • `CONTENT_ID`: `content_id`.
  • `CONTENT_NAME`: `content_name`.
  • `CONTENT_TYPE`: `content_type`.
  • `CURRENCY`: `currency`.
  • `DESCRIPTION`: `description`.
  • `EVENT_ID`: `event_id`.
  • `NUM_ITEMS`: `num_items`.
  • `PRICE`: `price`.
  • `SEARCH_STRING`: `search_string`.
  • `STATUS`: `status`.
  • `URL`: `url`.
  • `VALUE`: `value`.
| #|operator {Required}|string|Operator.

  • When `parameter` is `BRAND`, `CONTENT_CATEGORY`, `CONTENT_ID`, `CONTENT_NAME`, `CONTENT_TYPE`, `DESCRIPTION`, `EVENT_ID`, `SEARCH_STRING`, `STATUS`, or `URL`, the enum values are:
    • `CONTAIN`: Contains.
    • `NOT_CONTAIN`: Does not contain.
    • `START_WITH`: Starts with.
    • `EQUAL`: Is equal to.
    • `NOT_EQUAL`: Is not equal to.
  • When `parameter` is `NUM_ITEMS`, `PRICE`, or `VALUE`, the enum values are:
    • `EQUAL`: Is equal to.
    • `NOT_EQUAL`: Is not equal to.
    • `LT`: Is less than.
    • `GT`: Is greater than.
    • `LTE`: Is less than or equal to.
    • `GTE`: Is greater than or equal to.
  • When `parameter` is `CURRENCY`, the enum values are:
    • `EQUAL`: Is equal to.
    • `NOT_EQUAL`: Is not equal to.
| #|values {Required}|string[]|Values for the parameter.

  • When `parameter` is `BRAND`, `CONTENT_CATEGORY`, `CONTENT_ID`, `CONTENT_NAME`, `CONTENT_TYPE`, `DESCRIPTION`, `EVENT_ID`, `SEARCH_STRING`, `STATUS`, `URL`, the field will be an array of strings, each with a maximum length of 100 characters and up to 100 entries.
  • When `parameter` is `NUM_ITEMS`, the field will be an integer between 0 and 1,000,000,000.
  • When `parameter` is `PRICE`, `VALUE`, the field will be a float kept to two decimal places, within the range from 0.00 to 1,000,000,000.00.
  • When `parameter` is `CURRENCY`, the field will be an array of strings. To learn about the enum values, see List of currency values.| ``` ### List of values for `optimization_event` The following table lists of the enum values for `optimization_event` for different event source types.
